runtimeMapping.trait: All legal ground/air victims in the source range are resampled at CAST. The source 1-3 near grid applies 1.5x ATK; S1/S3 apply it throughout their range.
runtimeMapping.skill1: AUTO offensive recovery, source ATK and four-ammo holder. Native mode1 uses Skill Begin/Idle/Loop/End. The final shot ends immediately; manual cancellation is enabled.
runtimeMapping.skill2: Manual time recovery with two charges. The native enhance judge selects eight or twenty ammo, then clears every charge and partial SP. Source ATK, ground-only flat DEF and movement penalties, five-second fixed range field, .2-second polling and .25-second refresh tail.
runtimeMapping.skill3: Manual time recovery, source 2-6 range and ATK, simultaneous two-hit group at one original .5-second event, spending two of thirty-two ammo together. Source ground-only field/debuff parameters; final ammo retains the original attack tail.
runtimeMapping.talents: Frugality selects the source promotion/potential self chance and E2 other-Sniper chance. One maximum-probability roll saves the entire attack ammo spend. Vestiges adds source ASPD, with its extra bonus only for the actual water map tag.
runtimeMapping.animation: Original Front/Back and Down-facing Attack/Skill/Skill_1/Skill_2 clips with .5-second attack events, native time-mode rate capped at 1, fixed .1-second Begin/End. Both exact official facing chains match published SD bytes.

verificationLimits: Modules, native Unity particles and audio are not enabled. Original effect objects/references are retained as evidence; the liquid field has mechanics but no certified native particle rendering.

Original compiled FSM/Sequence dispatch is not executable here. Fixed startup, S2/S3 last-shot tail handoff, abnormal-state animation behavior, source stat rebasing and same-tick order require native game-frame comparison.

Native ON_ABILITY_START ammo saving is mapped to the shared performed-attack ammo hook, after delivered damage. Highest chance and whole-spend preservation are tested; native random stream order and interactions with same-attack deaths are not certified.

The native non-damage-missable .1-second direct liquid debuff is locally applied before physical mitigation, followed by field polling. Its ordering against a same-event native damage callback is not independently executed.
Overlapping fields share one replacement slime buff. Their equal-build penalties do not stack; strongest-wins resolution between different ranks or multiple producers is not certified.

Field polling starts immediately, samples the fixed source-facing grid against live ground bodies every .2 seconds, persists beyond source retreat and refreshes for .25 seconds. Exact native collision-edge, attach/finish and scheduler order are not certified.
The playable stage still contains only two basic enemies. Synthetic aerial, dodge, water-tag and status tests do not enable additional enemy types or certify their abilities.
